game_title: Stamina Climb – Mine Cart Tunnel Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stamina value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about stamina to power up the torchbearer and open the mine cart.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
